cs.t: Also agreed. I have been using Jabra earbuds daily for about four years and they would perfectly.

There might be something wrong with your Pixel. I use a fairly inexpensive set of Jabra headphones connected via Bluetooth to an old iPhone 5C that I use as an iPod and it has worked flawlessly for many years now.

- MacBook Pro 2020. This is my first personal Apple device (I already had a MacBook Pro 2019 for work) and I love it. It's expensive but really has a nice premium feeling and UX. The only comparable non-Apple ultrabook on the market was the last XPS 13 but it was actually MORE expensive than the MBP. - Jabra wireless earbuds. I was skeptical at first but they're amazing.
